subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error.

Factoring is, of course, different from and superior than bill discounting, from the point of view of a small company.

options.text: bill discounting, from the point of
Factoring is, of course, different from and superior than

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The part of the given sentence that has an error in it is:* 'Factoring is, of course, different from and superior than'*
 
• The **correct phrase **should be* "superior to"* not *"superior than."*</l
